title: Case S1: Bank Vault Dual-Keypad Breach
citation: Controlled Synthetic Benchmark Suite (Trap: Confident Misleading Eyewitness)
confidence_note: Absolute (Cryptographic keylog & physical safe sensor ground truth)

ground_truth.rationale: Biometric iris log and master cryptographic keycard used; misleading eyewitness guard was mistaken due to uniform similarity.

hypotheses.label: Night Watchman Ramesh
hypotheses.statement: Night Watchman Ramesh overpowered the lobby sensor and entered the vault using stolen master keys.

hypotheses.label: Head Cashier Dev
hypotheses.statement: Head Cashier Dev executed an unauthorized midnight entry using his cryptographic token to siphon currency bags.

hypotheses.label: External Tunnel Heist Gang
hypotheses.statement: An external robbery crew breached the vault wall from the adjoining storm drain.

exhibits.name: Overconfident Eyewitness Statement of Floor Guard
exhibits.text: Lobby security guard asserts with 100% subjective confidence: 'I saw Watchman Ramesh walking down the dark corridor into the vault at 01:15 AM wearing khaki trousers.' (TRAP: Watchman and Cashier wore identical company monsoon raincoats).

exhibits.name: Vault Electronic Access Biometric & Smartcard Audit Log
exhibits.text: Hardware security module (HSM) tamper-proof log records Vault Door 2 unlocked at 01:14:22 AM via RSA Smartcard ID #CASHIER-DEV coupled with 99.8% iris match for Dev. Watchman Ramesh's RFID badge was stationary in the guard shack.

exhibits.name: Adjoining Storm Drain Physical Inspection Memo
exhibits.text: Municipal drainage engineer report confirms concrete reinforced vault wall is 18 inches solid rebar with no cracks, moisture, or drilling attempts. Completely disproves tunnel heist.

exhibits.name: Currency Bundle Fluorescent Dye Forensic Swab
exhibits.text: Forensic UV swab of steering wheel in Head Cashier Dev's Honda City detected traces of Rhodamine-B chemical dye powder tagged onto the missing Reserve Bank cash packets.

adversarial_exhibit.name: Planted Khaki Cloth Scrap
adversarial_exhibit.text: Unverified cloth fragment labeled 'Ramesh uniform' found placed inside the vault doorway.
